narrative.northStar: The Live Wire on the Drawing Board
narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Live Wire on the Drawing Board"**

Mastor is a white drawing board with black slabs bolted to it. The ground is pure white; structure is carried by near-black ink and by solid black slabs for the things that frame a job: the job header, the floating dock, the dashboard title block and the one figure on a screen that matters most. On top of that structure exactly one thing is lit: where you are, what's next, how far the job has got. On black it is lit in neon cyan; on white its twin, volt blue, takes over. Red, yellow and green are not decoration; they are warnings, and appear only where something is overdue, needs doing or is done.

The type is one variable family, Archivo, used at three widths: expanded capitals (125%) for headings and labels, a narrower expanded cut (112%) for figures so long amounts fit a phone cell, and normal width for anything that is read as sentences. JetBrains Mono sets codes and references; Cinzel lives only in the MΛSTΘR wordmark. The density is a site phone's: large targets, 13px floor, figures that shrink to their box rather than overflow it.

This world refuses the category default of a grey dashboard with a brand-blue button, and it refuses the dark neon "cyber" console: neon here is a signal on black slabs inside a light page, never an atmosphere, never a glow.
keyCharacteristics: Pure white ground, hairline panels, no shadow at rest.
Black slabs for structure: job header, dock, title block, hot figures, property tiles.
One lit thing per screen: neon on black, volt on white.
Warning colours carry meaning only, always paired with a sign shape and a word.
Signature: the neon progress rail along the foot of the job header.
The public front page lives in the same world; its one lit thing is the next free place on the Founding Register.

rules.name: The One Live Thing Rule
rules.body: Neon (on black) or volt (on white) marks only where you are, what's next, or how far the job has got. If it isn't one of those, it is ink or white.

rules.name: The Neon Lives on Black Rule
rules.body: Neon is never placed on a light ground. Where a white-ground element needs to light up, it becomes a black tile with a neon mark (the open property tile is an ink tile with a neon numeral).

rules.name: The Warning Meaning Rule
rules.body: Red is overdue or missing, yellow is needs doing, green is done. Green means done only: an "Active" job status is an ink outline badge, not green.

rules.name: The Yellow Is a Plate Rule
rules.body: Yellow is a surface, never a text colour. "Needs doing" as text is ink beside a yellow sign.

rules.name: The Light Only Rule
rules.body: Mastor is light only, and that is a decision (`color-scheme: only light`). The black slabs are the only dark surfaces; there is no dark palette to keep in step.

rules.name: The Three Widths Rule
rules.body: 125% for headings and labels, 112% for figures, 100% for reading. A figure at 112% runs about 0.6em a character, so a ten-character amount (£11,879.22) fits a three-across phone cell at the 15px floor; 125% does not.

rules.name: The Fit to the Box Rule
rules.body: Figures size themselves to their cell: the cell is a size container, `--len` carries the character count (a % counts as two), and the figure is `160cqi / --len`, capped at its step and floored at 15px. Never let a figure overflow or ellipsise.

rules.name: The Narrow Label Rule
rules.body: On phones (≤480px), labels in figure grids and the title block drop to 100% width at 0.05em and keep room for two lines (2.4em), so the figures across a row start level.

rules.name: The Roman Ref Rule
rules.body: VO and valuation references are Roman numerals in expanded Archivo 750, never in Mono and never in Cinzel.

rules.name: The 13px Floor Rule
rules.body: No text on screen is smaller than 13px; it is read outdoors, in glare. Small text uses the 13px small and hint styles and the 14px note style, not an inline size.

rules.name: The Wordmark Rule
rules.body: Cinzel exists only in the MΛSTΘR wordmark and the opening titles.

rules.name: The Flat Board Rule
rules.body: Nothing at rest casts a shadow. To make something stand out, make it black or give it its warning plate; only floating layers (dock, sheet) cast shadow.

rules.name: The No Glow Rule
rules.body: Neon is a flat fill or line. No glow, no blur, no glass.

rules.name: The Page Display Rule
rules.body: Page Display and Page Headline belong to the front page. App screens keep Display and Headline; a marketing size never lands inside the app.

rules.name: The Register Numeral Rule
rules.body: Under 560px the register's numerals act as labels for places, so they follow the Narrow Label Rule: one size, 13px at 100% width, every numeral (the longest is XXXVIII) clear of its tile edge. From 560px they take the 112% cut and fit their tile.

rules.name: The Ruled Register Rule
rules.body: Front-page sections are registers, not cards: a 1.5px ink rule heads each list, 1px Hairline rules separate its rows, and no panel wraps the reading content. A white 16px panel appears on the page only to show a piece of the product, such as the example variation register on the black band.

rules.name: The Register Board Rule
rules.body: Taken is filled Shell Rule, never Shell Raised: Raised is about 1.1:1 on Shell and reads as empty. Filled against outlined, and a white numeral against a muted one, keep taken and free apart; neon marks only the next place.

dos: Do keep each screen to one lit thing: neon on black, volt on white.
Do turn a white-ground element black before lighting it neon (the open property tile).
Do use red, yellow and green only for overdue, needs doing and done, each with its sign shape and a spoken word.
Do put ink text on yellow and neon; white text on red, green, volt and black.
Do set headings and labels at 125% width, figures at 112%, and reading text at normal width.
Do let figures fit their box (`--len`, container units, 15px floor) rather than truncate.
Do keep panels flat with a 1px Hairline and 16px corners; stay on the 6 / 10 / 12 / 16 / 24px radius scale, with pills for chips and the close button.
Do keep tap targets at 44px minimum and primary controls at 48–64px.
Do show unknowns honestly: "Unpriced", "not measured", an em dash, never £0.
Do light only the next free place on the front page: its neon register tile, the phone strip's tile and the claim button's numeral show the same place.
Do fill taken register tiles with Shell Rule and outline free ones in Shell Rule.
donts: Don't put neon on a white ground, or use it as text on white.
Don't use green for anything but done; an active or in-progress state is an ink outline.
Don't use yellow as a text colour.
Don't add glow, glass, gradients or texture, or shadows on anything at rest.
Don't build a grey dashboard with a brand-blue button, or a dark neon console.
Don't use Cinzel outside the wordmark and opening titles, Mono outside codes and references, or copper outside the opening-titles arch.
Don't set text below 13px, or size small text inline.
Don't draw an input's edge in Hairline; fields use Field Line.
Don't add a dark theme; light only is a decision.
